close_reason: Clear error for missing registry entries + e2e registry fixed, commit dd8ecda34ff3
description: The go mapping implicitly depends on python (nix/buck2/mappings.nix, since 2026-01-22), and python's dynamicAttrs now reads ${registry.python} (added by 'fix(buck2): run Python tests with the toolchain's store-path interpreter', turnkey-vnm.20, on main since 2026-09-25). A consumer whose registry lacks python, like e2e brownfield-adoption's full registry override, fails evaluation: error: attribute 'python' missing at nix/buck2/mappings.nix:75. Reproduce: ./e2e/harness/runner.sh brownfield-adoption (fails on main and on the buck2-bundling map's commits alike). Found while resolving turnkey-luk.7.

comments.text: Fixed in dd8ecda34ff3 (not pushed): mappings.nix registry lookups go through a helper that names the missing entry and where to add it; brownfield-adoption's registry lists python, and the test passes (92s). Dev shell drv unchanged; CI gates pass.

title: [BUG] Go toolchain fails to evaluate when the registry has no python
